title: Keel Agent (keel/v1alpha1)
description: kind: Agent — spec section 14: a logical responsibility (e.g. an auditor) executed by an AgentExecutor, possibly a different model than the main session. Minimal Phase-2-seed form: role, the executor it routes to, an output schema its result is validated against, and a hard budget. A semantic verdict NEVER authorizes an irreversible action (section 4.7).

role.description: audit/review return findings without writing (section 14.10 auditor mode).

outputSchema.description: Path (workspace-relative) to the JSON Schema the AgentResult is validated against (invariant 12).
